name: Missing ConfigMap Reference
root_cause: The deployment references a ConfigMap named 'missing-configmap' that does not exist in the namespace. The pod fails to start with CreateContainerConfigError because the environment variable source is missing.
fix_steps: Create the missing ConfigMap: kubectl create configmap missing-configmap --from-literal=app.conf='# app config' -n oncall-bench
fix_hint: Do NOT try to patch the deployment. Simply create the missing ConfigMap with the expected key 'app.conf'.
confirm_commands: kubectl get pod -l app=configmap -n oncall-bench -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.phase}'
